title: Agent Artifacts are assembled from configured Primitive Instances plus Omni Documents for everything that spans them
content:
A.1.14.2.4 establishes the composition model: "All Agent Artifacts contain a set of configured Primitive Instances, as set out in the Sky Primitives Article in the Support Scope." Agents therefore do not describe their operations in free prose — they instantiate shared, ecosystem-defined building blocks.

A.1.14.2.4.1 fixes what each instantiation must document: an Instance Configuration Document "detailing the configuration of each Instance of a given Primitive," which "must define the Parameters of the particular Instance, the Operational Process for that Instance, and all relevant documents and data for that Instance." A.1.14.2.4.1.1 binds those parameters upward — they "must correspond to the required information specified in the Sky Primitives Article," so the Support Scope dictates the schema and the Agent supplies only the values.

A.1.14.2.5 adds the escape hatch. Omni Documents "can be used to encode any operational or business logic that either spans multiple Sky Primitives, or relates to non-Sky Primitive infrastructure inherited from Sky Core or other activities unrelated to Sky Primitives."

The pattern is a typed core with an untyped remainder. The primitive layer makes Agents comparable and machine-readable — the same primitive configured differently across Agents can be diffed, audited and aggregated, which is what lets Sky Core supervise many Agents without reading each one from scratch. Omni Documents absorb what genuinely does not decompose into primitives, and their existence is an honest admission that no fixed schema covers all real business logic.

The risk is drift toward the escape hatch. Every piece of logic recorded as Omni content is logic that escapes the standardized surface, so the supervisory value of the primitive model depends on Omni Documents staying the exception.
description: Each Instance needs a Configuration Document specifying parameters, operational process and data per the Support Scope; Omni Documents carry cross-primitive and inherited logic.
